about_short_description.short_description: IOMETE is the Sovereign Data Platform. IOMETE was built to give enterprises and governments back control over their data.

product.name: IOMETE Data Lakehouse Platform
product.description: A self-hosted data lakehouse platform that integrates data warehousing, governance, engineering, and analytics for enterprise use.

product.name: IOMETE Data Mesh Architecture
product.description: A data mesh implementation enabling domain-oriented, distributed data ownership and federated governance within enterprises.

product.name: IOMETE Data Security Features
product.description: Enterprise-grade data security controls including access management, authentication, encryption, and audit logging within a self-hosted environment.

product.name: IOMETE Integrations and Data Ecosystem
product.description: Open core architecture enabling seamless integration with BI tools, ETL platforms, and machine learning frameworks using standard interfaces.

product.name: IOMETE AI Lakehouse Capabilities
product.description: A data platform foundation supporting AI initiatives with data quality controls, governance, and secure access.

product.name: IOMETE Business Intelligence Integration
product.description: Connectivity to major BI tools via standard SQL endpoints with security and performance optimizations.
